checks.evidence: Dimensioned apartment subassemblies, fasteners, sash/rail/AC detail tooling exists; generated window optics separates two sliding glass leaves from the frame and interior backing instead of relying on one opaque window block.
Generated detail geometry has a non-razor-edge replacement pass.
Danchi master geometry has explicit LOD staging.
Two-sided foliage optics and transmission shader are present.

Weathering is driven by rain/splash/drain/contact/UV context rather than arbitrary grime; facade optics and physical environment lighting do not bake rain streaks, shadows or sky highlights into base albedo.

PBR generation includes physical-scale infrastructure micro maps, metre-derived macro/detail base-ground layers, and a two-scale non-metallic facade coating. Clear glazing is a non-metallic premultiplied Transparent Standard material with non-emissive interior backing, replacing the old opaque blue-gray window rendering while retaining base colliders.

One deterministic midsummer solar model now drives the SummerSun, procedural sky sun reference, sky-derived ambient fill and default specular environment. Two 512px HDR local reflection probes use ViaScripting/NoTimeSlicing refresh and outdoor BlendProbesAndSkybox renderer policy; subtle linear atmospheric depth is specified without near-field color wash.
Generated fallbacks remain replaceable by authored FBX/GLB art; facade optics explicitly skips when the danchi authored-art slot is active.

Per-component manufacture/material/angular-light-response registry exists, with explicit foundation/grade and facade/glazing contracts. The glazing contract records construction, nominal pane thickness concept, IOR/F0 reference, roughness, transmission proxy, mounting/depth separation, forbidden responses and frontal/oblique/grazing lookdev criteria. Environment lookdev separately defines the observable angular reflection, shadow/sky coherence and probe-seam requirements needed to judge those materials.

Dedicated 3840x2160 hero/oblique/grazing capture code with pixel-exact 100% crops rebuilds and validates infrastructure microdetail, metric anti-repeat base ground, physical grade/contact interfaces, facade/glazing optics, then the saved procedural sky/reflection environment. After the final scene reopen it re-validates lighting and requests both realtime probes immediately before capture.
Capture contract records exact view/crop paths plus the intended sky/reflection state and explicitly remains unrendered until Unity executes it.
No actual Unity 6.3 editor/runner compile verification artifact exists yet.

expectedVisualScoreImpact: Lighting/shadows/reflections: the visible procedural sky, ambient source and scene key all share the stored midsummer SummerSun, directly targeting sun/shadow inconsistency and the previous flat ambient/specular environment. Two local HDR probes cover the facade and park/ground context while renderers blend probes back to the skybox.

Material/PBR physical plausibility: the dielectric glazing and rough painted/metal surfaces now have an actual view-dependent environment to reflect; this is expected to make Fresnel response observable rather than compensating with baked highlights. No points are awarded until the frontal/oblique/grazing renders demonstrate the response.

Cinematic image quality/color/exposure: the capture camera is forced to HDR against the skybox and subtle 72-148 m linear atmospheric depth is defined to separate far geometry without a near-field blue overlay. Highlight clipping, sky color and shadow density still require real rendered evidence.

Temporal/aliasing stability: local probes refresh ViaScripting with NoTimeSlicing immediately before benchmark capture instead of EveryFrame, removing a likely source of time-varying reflection state during the still benchmark. Actual moving-camera probe seams and stability remain unverified.

Critical-defect prevention: QA now rejects a different sky sun vs shadow sun, disabled realtime probes, missing HDR probe state, non-sky ambient/default reflection, non-HDR camera, or renderers that fail the outdoor probe-to-sky blending contract.
